tips.text: Start the Akstiletto research right away; the four 72 hour timers, not the resources, are the long wait.
Stock Salvage, Polymer Bundle and Ferrite before the last research step; it takes 15,500 Salvage and 11,500 Ferrite at once.
Build the Tenno Lab first; research timers do not run in a clan without one.
Gather Plastids, Ferrite and Nano Spores on the same planets as one route; you pick up most Spores passively.
Nobody treats the Gunsen as a hard farm; Tellurium is the only complaint.
